description: This file defines the `ExecSystemRunCommandValidator` enum, which provides static methods and nested types to validate, resolve, and manage shell command invocations and environment manipulations within a system execution context. It includes logic for parsing command strings, handling different shell wrappers, inline commands, environment variable assignments, and recursion through nested invocation wrappers.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Validates and resolves a command array and raw command string into a `ValidationResult`, generating a display string and evaluating whether raw commands are permissible.

methods.name: allowlistEvaluationRawCommand
methods.description: Checks if a raw command string is allowed for evaluation based on the command array, considering shell wrappers and environment manipulations.

methods.name: hasEnvManipulationBeforeShellWrapper
methods.description: Determines whether the command array contains environment variable manipulations that occur prior to invoking a shell wrapper.
